visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit room with white walls and soft curtains, a man with a yellow beanie, yellow scarf, and a red sweater stands before the camera. He presses his palms together in a greeting gesture. Large yellow text with a black outline appears in the center, framed against the neutral indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a highway packed with stationary cars of various colors. Then, the man appears inside a car cabin, wearing the same outfit, holding a clear plastic bottle and two wooden drumsticks. He stares blankly at the lens with a serious expression. (3) Close-up shots show dark coffee-colored liquid being poured into the plastic bottle. The man uses the drumsticks to tap on the bottle, demonstrating a rhythmic motion while seated in the passenger seat. He then looks upward with wide eyes and an open mouth, conveying a sense of exaggerated relief or epiphany. (4) Transitioning back to the indoor setting, the man puts on large, red and black industrial-style earmuffs. Intercut scenes show the man in different costumes: first as an elderly relative with a grey wig and glasses, then as a child with a red hat playing with plush rabbit dolls in a yellow shirt. (5) A wide shot displays several white storage shelves densely packed with colorful action figures and character models. The man holds a roll of white tape and a cup. He is shown kneeling on the floor, using the tape to outline a human body silhouette on the tiles to deter visitors. (6) The man pulls a long strip of yellow "Caution" tape across the shelves to block access to his collection. He gives a thumbs-up to the camera. Subsequent shots show him holding several bright red and gold scratch-off lottery tickets, looking extremely excited with a wide, energetic smile on his face. (7) The man holds a very long, connected sheet of lottery tickets, displaying them proudly. He appears again in the "relative" costume, looking surprised. The main character then aggressively scratches a ticket on a wooden table, shouting with joy and raising his fists in victory while papers fly around him in the air.
